title: Kula Today
heading: Today · Thu 19 Nov
summary: A light day (forecast light). Thermals stayed light all day. The upslope ran from about 08:45 to about 16:30. Yesterday evening, the page called it normal, about 5,100 ft, a hit. Midday the base averaged about 5,100 ft by the Kekoa camera, right on yesterday evening's number; the morning update said about 5,000 ft, off by 100 ft; at 10:00, from the 09:00 base, about 4,800 ft, off by 300 ft. Most of the day the shear line was crossing Kula Highway near Omaopio; furthest north about 09:52, crossing Kula Highway near Kamehameha Schools. Data gaps: no readings all day from 1 station (Nakula); Kahikinui stopped at 13:30; Upper Kahikinui stopped at 14:30; the Mesonet could not be reached on 11 of 54 updates.
